## ProviderConnectionService

Manages provider connections: an upstream credential + endpoint config.  Every provider kind may have multiple connections with distinct names and  non-null prefixes.

## ProviderConnectionModel

One model reachable through a saved provider connection. The public id is  what callers send to the router; the upstream id is what usage records use.

## SavedProviderConnectionDraft

Tests a complete draft using a saved connection's credential when api_key is  blank. The provider kind must match the saved connection. Other draft fields  override the saved test settings. Nothing is persisted.

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connection_id` (`connectionId`) | 1 | `string` | implicit default |  |
